messages.author: 54d4981d6bf68eaf
messages.subject: issue with starday parameter?
parts:
Hi Mike, 

I am trying to run some simulations starting from a day of the year different than 1. I was able to do it before (i.e. starting the simulation from day 140, for some lizards that lay the eggs around that date), but now the program gives some strange results (including max and min experienced temperatures of 0 for the whole sim). Here is a minimal example to reproduce the problem, using default parameters:

library(NicheMapR)
micro <- micro_global(nyear=3, timeinterval=365)

ecto <- ectotherm(DEB=1, startday=1)
data.frame(ecto$yearsout)

OUTPUT:
  YEAR MaxStg    MaxWgt   MaxLen     Tmax      Tmin    MinRes MaxDes MinShade
1    1      1  2.412214 52.00291 30.74452 -9.300697 0.6886385      0        0
2    2      1  6.245361 70.59970 29.99988  6.007910 0.3728264      0        0
3    3      1 10.594138 83.81015 29.99991  6.012277 0.4996006      0        0

ecto <- ectotherm(DEB=1, startday=2)
data.frame(ecto$yearsout)

OUTPUT:
YEAR MaxStg MaxWgt    MaxLen         Tmax         Tmin MinRes MaxDes MinShade
1    1      0      0 0.4027711 7.888609e-29 7.888609e-29      1      0        0
2    2      0      0 0.7391942 7.888609e-29 7.888609e-29      1      0        0
3    3      0      0 1.0756154 7.888609e-29 7.888609e-29      1      0        0

Are you experiencing the same problem? Or is it related to my system?

All the best,
Urtzi

micro <- micro_global(nyear=3, timeinterval=365) ecto <- ectotherm(DEB=1, startday=1) data.frame(ecto$yearsout)

library(NicheMapR) micro <- micro_global(nyear=3, timeinterval=365) ecto <- ectotherm(DEB=1, startday=1) data.frame(ecto$yearsout)

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: issue with starday parameter?
parts:
Thanks for discovering this Urtzi - I think it's now fixed on the latest push to github. It was an initialisation issue where the initial DEB state was being set to zero rather than the inputted initial conditions when startday was > 1.

All the best,
Mike
